en.html:
Yoshikiyo"A side of my lord you never knew—that is what you said I knew, no? Haan. I knew! I knew him!"
Yoshikiyo"He was kind! Our parents were dead. My sister and I had nothing left but to follow them. My lord saved us!"
Yoshikiyo"Long ago, our parents helped him in some small matter. He remembered! For that alone, he took us in. Whatever danger it brought him, he did not care."
Yoshikiyo"Raised us. Even gave us warrior rank."
Yoshikiyo"How much could we thank him? Never enough. But every time he would laugh. 'I am a basara fellow. What I wanted, I did. That is all.'"
Yoshikiyo"HE WAS KIND!! There. Satisfied? You wanted to hear this, didn't you?"
Yoshikiyo"What kind of man he was—you wanted to know!!"
Masamune《............》
Masamune《B... but... That man...》
Yoshikiyo"Yes, of course. All sorts of bad things also he did. His own desires, those were all he obeyed."
Yoshikiyo"So? Does that change who he was to me?"
Masamune《............》
Yoshikiyo"Heh... ahahaha! No use! Now I am saying all this—what use is it now?"
Yoshikiyo"He's dead already. My lord..."
Yoshikiyo"My sister also."
Yoshikiyo"The baby who should have been born!"
Masamune《U... uhh...》
Masamune《A baby... ...A baby, you say...》
Yoshikiyo"Killed. You killed them."
Yoshikiyo"That one, you killed also. Didn't you?"
Masamune《N-no...》
Yoshikiyo"No? Why are you denying it...?"
Yoshikiyo"Just now, such confidence you had. Come, chest out. Properly."
Yoshikiyo"My lord was evil, so you killed him with my pregnant sister and her unborn child. All together. Say it!"
Yoshikiyo"Kill me also. Then what more could I ask!"
Masamune《Pregnant... ...Impossible...》
Masamune《That was what the Mongols did...! I... so that such a tragedy would never happen again...》
Masamune《...Ah...》
Masamune《Agh...》

義清「私が、貴方たちの知らない入道様を知って いるだろうって……？ 　ああ、知っている！　知っているよ！」
義清「優しい御方だった！ 　両親を失くして、後を追うばかりだった私 と姉さんを助けて下さったのは入道様だ！」
義清「両親が昔、些細な事件で、入道様を助けた ことがあったのを覚えていて下されたから！ 　たったそれだけのことで、入道様は危険も 顧みずに私たちの身柄を引き取ってくれた」
義清「育ててくれた。 　士分に取り立ててさえ下さった」
義清「いくら感謝したってし足りない。 　だのに入道様は、いつも笑って仰るだけだ った……わしは婆娑羅者、おのれのやりたい ことをやっただけよ、と」
義清「――優しい御方だった!! 　さあ、どうだ!?　満足か？　聞きたかった んだろう？」
義清「入道様がどんなお人か、知りたかったんだ ろう!!」
正宗《…………》
正宗《……だ……だが……。 　あの男は……》
義清「ああ、そうだね。 　入道様は悪いことも色々なされた。ご自分 の欲にのみ忠実な御方だったから」
義清「けれどだからって、私にとっての入道様が 変わるわけじゃない」
正宗《…………》
義清「ふふ……あはははは！ 　仕方ない！　今更、こんなこと言ったって 仕方ないよ！」
義清「もう死んでしまったんだ。 　入道様は……」
義清「姉さんも」
義清「生まれるはずだった赤子も！」
正宗《う……うぅ……》
正宗《赤子…… 　……赤子だと…………》
義清「殺した。 　貴方が殺したんだ」
義清「それ・・は貴方が殺したんだよ？」
正宗《ち、違う……》
義清「違わないさ。 　どうして否定なんかするんだい……？」
義清「さっきまであんなに、堂々としていたじゃ ないか。 　ちゃんと胸を張ってよ」
義清「入道様が悪人だったから！ 　妊婦の姉さんと胎児ごと、まとめて殺して しまったんだって、言えばいいだろう！」
義清「それで私も殺してくれれば言う事はない！」
正宗《妊婦…… 　……馬鹿な……》
正宗《それは……蒙古の所業……！ 　吾は……あのような惨劇を二度と起こさぬ ために……》
正宗《……ア……》
正宗《アガッ……》

Yoshikiyo"Any moment it looks ready to break."
Masamune《G-GAH—GEH-GEGEGAGAGA》
Yoshikiyo"What are you doing? Why should you feel ashamed?"
Yoshikiyo"Justice only you did, no?"
Yoshikiyo"Not one blemish on your blade, correct?"
Yoshikiyo"Yes, exactly! Such beautiful indigo steel..."
Yoshikiyo"With the blood of the unborn child you killed, like a field of morning glories in all their colours! So beautiful!"
Masamune《GAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!》

I gripped Masamune's head with my right hand.
At the same time, I clenched my teeth.

Bit the piece of flesh there.
Tasted decay.

My own filth. That was the taste.
My own entrails, rotted through.

Below, a town was suffering merciless violence.
People were being robbed of their lives and property. No right to take them, and still they were taken.

As Masamune, I had the strength to protect them. To fight for them.
So we would go.

We had to hurry—
